explanation: J.J. Thomson discovered the electron through his cathode ray tube experiments.
distractor_rationale: Rutherford discovered the nucleus. Bohr gave the planetary model. Chadwick discovered the neutron.

ai_context.learning_goal: Identify the scientists who discovered subatomic particles.
ai_context.hint: Think of the plum pudding model.

explanation: Isotopes are atoms of the same element (same atomic number) having different mass numbers because they have a different number of neutrons.
distractor_rationale: Isotopes have the SAME chemical properties because they have the same number of electrons. They have DIFFERENT physical properties.

ai_context.learning_goal: Differentiate between the physical and chemical properties of isotopes.
common_misconceptions: Believing isotopes have different chemical properties.
ai_context.hint: Chemical properties depend on electrons. Do isotopes have different electrons?

question_text: Calcium (Atomic number 20) and Argon (Atomic number 18) both have a mass number of 40. They are known as:
explanation: Atoms of different elements with different atomic numbers but the same mass number are called Isobars.
distractor_rationale: Isotopes have the SAME atomic number. Here, the atomic numbers are different (20 and 18).

ai_context.learning_goal: Apply the definition of isobars to real elements.
ai_context.hint: They have different atomic numbers but the SAME mass.
